notes.title: Wasted Pizza In Humble Bundle's Yogscast Jingle Jam 2017 100% To Charity
notes.notes:
Hello, 

We are happy to announce that Wasted Pizza is participating in Humble Bundles' Yogscast Jingle Jam 2017 which 100% of the revenue goes to charity.
So go get your bundle now that has over 800$ worth of games in it and that everything is donated to charity
[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/yogscast-jingle-jam-2017]Click Here To View The Bundle[/url]

Thanks, and have a great one ːsteamhappyː
